Très bien emballé. Facile à monter avec les outils fournis. Le tout semble assez solide et bien pensée. Pour l'instant, je n'ai posé que deux kayaks de mer en fibre sur les supports du bas. Pas encore utilisé avec 4 kayaks. Ce matériel semble bien.

The kayak stand was much heavier than I expected. Assembly was pretty straightforward except the names of certain parts were different in the part list than in the instructions. All in all, I am very happy with the stand. I expect it to last quite a while. I would by this stand again.

Pretty good rack for the price compared to others on the market. No complaints at all in fact bought another one for another property. It does come in segments so you can split the rack into 2 separate racks, which is what I did and that was pretty perfect for me. Again no complaints happy with it, do recommend.
